title: More organic food from English farms
titleZh: 来自英格兰农场的更多有机食品
summaryZh: 英格兰发布有机农业行动计划，希望帮助农民生产和销售更多有机食品。
levelReason: 短句为主，以农场、商店和购物为具体场景；少量有机农业词汇有中文释义，区分计划与已实现结果。

sentences.text: A new plan in England aims to bring more organic food from farms to shops and restaurants.
sentences.zh: 英格兰的一项新计划旨在把更多有机食品从农场送到商店和餐馆。

sentences.text: The government published the plan on 14 October 2026.
sentences.zh: 政府于2026年10月14日发布了这项计划。

sentences.text: It wants to help farmers who already produce organic food and farmers who are thinking about a change.
sentences.zh: 该计划希望帮助已经生产有机食品的农民，以及正在考虑转变生产方式的农民。

sentences.text: These farmers will be able to get advice and support.
sentences.zh: 这些农民将能够获得建议和支持。

sentences.text: The plan also aims to make it easier to sell their food.
sentences.zh: 该计划还旨在让他们更容易销售自己的食品。

sentences.text: Food needs to move from farms to the places where people buy it.
sentences.zh: 食品需要从农场运送到人们购买食品的地方。

sentences.text: The government wants this journey to be quicker for organic products.
sentences.zh: 政府希望有机产品的这一运输过程更快。

sentences.text: It also wants more people to know about English organic food.
sentences.zh: 政府还希望更多人了解英格兰的有机食品。

sentences.text: About 3.4% of agricultural land in England is farmed organically, according to the announcement.
sentences.zh: 公告称，英格兰约3.4%的农业用地采用有机耕作方式。

sentences.text: The plan aims to move towards 10% by 2036.
sentences.zh: 该计划的目标是到2036年向10%迈进。

sentences.text: This is a goal for the future, so it does not mean the change has already happened.
sentences.zh: 这是一个未来目标，因此并不意味着变化已经发生。

sentences.text: Farmers will still choose the way of farming that works best for their businesses.
sentences.zh: 农民仍将选择最适合自己经营的耕作方式。

sentences.text: For shoppers, the plan promises more choice in local shops, supermarkets and restaurants.
sentences.zh: 对于购物者，这项计划承诺在本地商店、超市和餐馆提供更多选择。

sentences.note: so连接原因与结果；does not mean后接完整从句，帮助区分目标与事实。

questions.zh: 你在商店挑选食品时，最看重什么？
